# Permission error transport observations

The expected rows were captured in a fresh Developer scratch org with a
synthetic Standard User. The native project declared a ReadWrite custom object
and a custom text field. The local synthetic fixture uses a different object and
field name while preserving the captured object and field types. The user had no object grant, read-only object access, or an
assigned permission set granting read/create/edit and field read/edit. Named
`@IsTest` runs covered source APIs 62 and 67; anonymous runs were the
administrator control. The scratch org was deleted and deletion was verified.

`user_mode_dml_transport.tsv` carries exact partial-insert SaveResult status,
message, ID-null state, field count, and measured DML statement/row deltas. It
records scalar and homogeneous list calls. The counter deltas were measured for
both APIs, including the two-row list case. `security_enforced_permission_messages.tsv`
records dynamic-query messages for denied and field-denied projections. At API
67 the clause is unsupported before permission evaluation.

The immutable native capture packet source is commit `2c767902b461f900eab15771e499a612c2ed4d14`; measured list-DML deltas are in supplemental packet `a7430198ebf4da56594f0b704ba6b9f4bb656df1`.

`failed_write_overloads.tsv` records the native two-row all-or-none USER_MODE outcomes and omitted-mode scalar outcomes, with exact DML statement/row deltas and post-transaction persistence counts. Route provenance for the initial exception/message rows is in `probes/ROAD-463-failure-details.tsv`; the subsequent counter/persistence measurements used a fresh scratch org and were deleted after capture.
